areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Digital services and a low-carbon power supply system make the public service greener and more resource-efficient.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Low-carbon power supply system with three dedicated indicators on data-centre efficiency, building efficiency and distributed generation.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Digital services modernize and cut red tape for businesses, and better digital infrastructure attracts investment.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Digital infrastructure densification targets the least developed, most socioeconomically vulnerable regions of the state.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Gender policy is clearly identified, with training for female civil servants, women-specific modules, a specific indicator and a youth training centre.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Specific action developing digital services and training civil servants in digital skills improves service delivery.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Digital backbone infrastructure represents a substantial technological innovation for the state.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Support to sanitation services is only an indirect effect of digital infrastructure, not a direct action.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Support to water monitoring is only an indirect effect of digital infrastructure.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Forest monitoring and biodiversity benefits are indirect effects of digital and energy-efficiency actions, not a specific policy.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Gains accrue to the whole business environment; no action specific to micro and small firms.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Poverty and job effects are indirect and generalized, not a policy specific to vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Digital skills product for vulnerable groups is potentially relevant, but targeting, groups, identification criteria and a specific indicator are not defined.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Telemedicine and school connectivity are potential spillovers; no specific health or education policy.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Private participation at the contracting stage is standard to all projects and does not qualify as an incentive.
